bio: All you would hope for from a contemporary-minded traditional inn! The regional and seasonal cuisine, which takes inspiration from classic Austrian fare, showcases carefully selected ingredients and impressive craftsmanship. Diners delight in dishes such as beef soup with shredded pancakes, organic char meunière, Backfleisch (breaded and fried meat) and Palatschinken (crêpes), as well as a selection of increasingly hard to find offal dishes. The extensive and well-curated wine list includes an appealing range of wines by the glass. Service comes courtesy of the friendly and attentive front-of-house team. Guests are seated at simply yet elegantly laid tables in an inviting dining space with all the charm of a Viennese tavern. Be sure to cast an eye over the well-stocked cheese display case....
